# vm-stat

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: macOS vm_stat output, parsed: parseVmStat (page size and every counter), availableMemBytes (free + speculative + inactive — what the system can hand out without swapping) and wiredMemBytes (kernel wired memory, which no process footprint carries).
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `debug/health-monitor`
    - `debug/sentinel/machine-usage`
- Core:
  - Exports (types): `VmStat`
  - Exports (values):
    - `availableMemBytes`
    - `parseVmStat`
    - `processMemBytes`
    - `wiredMemBytes`
